name: Blueberry Hill of Unity
tagline: Link to Blueberry Hill of Unity Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/blueberryhillofunity
description: Blueberry Hill of Unity is a small pumpkin patch in 72 Copeland Brook Road, NH. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
